title: Ethiopian Flower Tagine
description: A fragrant and flavorful dish from Ethiopia, featuring a rich floral tagine sauce with energizing spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the honey, coconut milk, and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
